purpose: Create authoritative CORE table for Nexus competition display mapping
statements: CREATE TABLE `IMC Competition Nexus Mapping` (`mapping_id` BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`game_world_id` VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,`world_type` ENUM('SINGLE','MULTI') NOT NULL,`sm_country` VARCHAR(100) NULL,`competition_group` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,`sm_action` VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,`sm_division` VARCHAR(16) NULL,`competition_key` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,`nexus_view` VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,`updated_at` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,PRIMARY KEY (`mapping_id`),UNIQUE KEY `uq_competition_key` (`competition_key`),KEY `idx_lookup` (`game_world_id`,`competition_group`,`sm_action`,`sm_division`),KEY `idx_country` (`game_world_id`,`sm_country`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
